gloss: to polish up; to refine; to perfect

definitions.explanation: To work dough or similar material until it reaches the desired consistency.

definitions.gloss: to polish up; to refine; to perfect
definitions.explanation: To carefully develop and improve something through repeated effort.

examples.japanese: {企画|きかく}を{練|ね}り{上|あ}げるのに{何|なん}{週間|しゅうかん}もかかった。
examples.english: It took weeks to refine the plan.

examples.japanese: {作家|さっか}は{何度|なんど}も{推敲|すいこう}して{文章|ぶんしょう}を{練|ね}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The author polished the text through repeated revisions.

examples.japanese: {生地|きじ}をしっかり{練|ね}り{上|あ}げてください。
{粘土|ねんど}を{練|ね}り{上|あ}げて{器|うつわ}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To knead clay and make a vessel.

examples.japanese: {餡|あん}をなめらかになるまで{練|ね}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I kneaded the bean paste until it was smooth.

examples.japanese: チーム{全員|ぜんいん}で{時間|じかん}をかけて{戦略|せんりゃく}を{練|ね}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The whole team took their time to carefully develop the strategy.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{練|ね}り{上|あ}げる → {練|ね}り{上|あ}げない (negative)
・{練|ね}り{上|あ}げる → {練|ね}り{上|あ}げて (te-form)
・{練|ね}り{上|あ}げる → {練|ね}り{上|あ}げた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {練|ね}る (to knead, to polish) + {上|あ}げる (to complete)

USAGE:
・{戦略|せんりゃく}を{練|ね}り{上|あ}げる (to refine a strategy)
・{脚本|きゃくほん}を{練|ね}り{上|あ}げる (to polish a script)
・アイデアを{練|ね}り{上|あ}げる (to develop an idea)

The ～{上|あ}げる pattern indicates completion or perfection of an action.
